item.title: How to seed databases in Node.js
item.description: Seeding databases in Node.js automates the population of initial data for development, testing, and production environments, ensuring consistent application state across deployments. As the creator of CoreUI with extensive Node.js experience since 2014, I’ve implemented database seeding systems in numerous enterprise applications for reliable development workflows and testing automation. The most effective approach involves creating structured seed scripts that can populate databases with sample data, user accounts, and configuration settings in a repeatable manner. This method provides consistent development environments while supporting both initial setup and ongoing data maintenance for application testing and demonstration.
